newsitem.title: UK: Multicanal sets two-tranche bond total $250 mln.
newsitem.headline: Multicanal sets two-tranche bond total $250 mln.

text.p: Multicanal has set a two-tranche bond for $125 million each via joint lead managers CSFB (New York) and Bank of Boston.
The bonds are still to be priced.
